verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's Coach product scores 100% of conversations against quality standards (exceeding a sampled-QA claim) and diagnose/root-cause tooling flags failures, while Simulations lets teams replay flagged/real tickets in bulk, compare outcomes, and push workflow fixes back via natural-language editing — closing the review loop. missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the QA scoring in practice and clearer detail on how flagged-failure alerts automatically trigger workflow fix deployment.
